name: PTEN m8 s2 2024-02-06  ·  Doppler 20–300 Hz
note: Detected by Doppler on the VACC, Storm line length (validated on the PTEN hand-sorts). Validated on the PTEN hand-sorts (every confirmed IED caught). Decimated to 2000 Hz, common-average referenced per probe bank, detected on even channels, kept when 7 or more took part. Band-passed 20–300 Hz after a 60 Hz notch. Line-length window 15 ms, threshold at the 99.9th percentile of the line-length values pooled over the 32 channels that were read (2 marked bad were not read at all, so they neither started events nor took part in the threshold). Each stamp is the largest deflection inside the detector’s window, measured only on the channels that took part. Times are seconds from the start of the recording, converted from the joined signal through this recording’s gap map. Detected on the 32 even channels: CSC2, CSC4, CSC6, CSC8, CSC10, CSC12, CSC14, CSC16, CSC18, CSC20, CSC22, CSC24, CSC26, CSC28, CSC30, CSC32, CSC34, CSC36, CSC38, CSC40, CSC42, CSC44, CSC46, CSC48, CSC50, CSC52, CSC54, CSC56, CSC58, CSC60, CSC62, CSC64.
